title: Kissed Juicy Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: Grassy, juicy, cozy Saudi-Arabian dish featuring cinnamon stick, this air-fry recipe is Whole30-friendly and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the air fryer basket, leaving some space between each skewer.
Air fry the lamb kebabs for 10-12 minutes, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
After 5 minutes of cooking, add the broken cinnamon sticks to the air fryer basket.
Once the lamb kebabs are cooked, brush them with lemon juice.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
